title: Settlement strand-braid cultural fabric
scope: Qualitative strand-braid cultural fabric and layered System-practice variation for the mixed refuge settlement; names, languages, faith content, protagonist origin, demographics, rituals, governance terms, harvest institutions, settlement-zone placement, and all natural System behaviour remain open or unchanged.
approval_evidence: On 2026-08-17 the Author selected 'A — STRAND-BRAID' from the displayed multiple-choice options, accepting Option A exactly as drafted together with the proposal's shared claim set.
question: Which qualitative integration pattern governs the mixed refuge community's cultural fabric — how origin strands persist, braid, fade, or cluster, and how System understanding and use varies across them — without choosing names, languages, faith content, the protagonist's origin culture, demographic percentages, specific rituals, governance or compact terms, any new System mechanic or CAL0 change, or any settlement-zone placement, harvest technique, or shore institution left open by the LOCATION and ECOLOGY records?
selection: Use A — STRAND-BRAID, plus the proposal's shared claim set. Several persistent origin strands keep distinct household-level traditions — foodways, teaching lines, memory-keeping, work customs — while daily work, defence, and seasonal festivals braid them together under negotiated common institutions; no strand dissolves and no strand dominates. The strand classes — locally rooted pre-collapse families, displaced arrivals from failed districts, ex-imperial functionary or garrison descendants, and itinerant-craft or trade lineages — are open-ended qualitative classes, and households may straddle them. Routine cross-strand crewing exists for lake-road haulage and corridor-season watches; festivals keyed to the seasonal rhythms are common institutions with distinguishable strand contributions. Views of the imperial inheritance run as a lived spectrum — salvage-pragmatism, nostalgia, resentment, taboo — across and within strands, and System practice varies by class of use — everyday pragmatic use, hoarded craft advantage, specialist study, folk belief and misinterpretation — cross-cutting the strands. Every such claim is cultural (records, access, belief, interpretation, presentation); natural System behaviour is unchanged, no readout is guaranteed, and no strand's account is privileged.
alternatives: A — STRAND-BRAID: Several persistent origin strands keep distinct household traditions while daily work, defence, and seasonal festivals braid them together under negotiated common institutions; almost every working crew, defence muster, and festival is deliberately mixed, and attitude and System-practice spectra distribute across and within strands. Selected.

B — CRUCIBLE: One emergent settlement identity dominates public life; origin traditions persist mainly privately and are generationally fading, with the founding-generation gap itself a live tension, and public attitudes and usage lore compress toward a settlement consensus that grants no truer access. Not selected.

C — QUARTER-MOSAIC: Origin communities cluster spatially with recognised brokers mediating between them; common institutions are thin, festivals are cluster-held with reciprocal guesting, attitudes and lores sort visibly by cluster, and broker knowledge is comparative and fallible, not privileged. Not selected.
rationale: The selected pattern preserves the capture's mixed-refuge character as a continuing lived fact rather than a fading origin story, gives the approaching first succession its richest legitimate constituency texture without pre-writing the compact, and keeps maximum protagonist-origin flexibility because every strand stays distinct and every strand is braided into common life.
evidence: Author selection on 2026-08-17: 'A — STRAND-BRAID' chosen from the displayed multiple-choice options, with the proposal's shared claim set.
consequences: Several persistent origin strands coexist, keeping distinct household-level traditions while sharing negotiated common institutions for work, defence, and festivals; no strand dissolves and no strand dominates.

The strand classes include, non-exhaustively: locally rooted pre-collapse families; displaced arrivals from failed districts; ex-imperial functionary or garrison descendants; and itinerant-craft or trade lineages; households may straddle classes.

Routine cross-strand crewing exists for lake-road haulage within WLD-LOCATION-002's fair-weather bands and for corridor-season watches and closures under WLD-ECOLOGY-004; in surge seasons mixed crews are the negotiated compact-era custom, not an arithmetic necessity.
Settlement festivals keyed to the seasonal rhythms are common institutions with distinguishable strand contributions; no ritual, calendar date, or observance content is established.
Views of the imperial inheritance form a lived spectrum — salvage-pragmatism, nostalgia, resentment, taboo — with strand-level leanings but no single settlement attitude and no strand unanimity.

System practice varies by class of use — everyday pragmatic use, hoarded craft advantage, specialist study, folk belief and misinterpretation — cross-cutting the strands; all such practice is cultural and none changes, reveals, or guarantees any natural System behaviour or readout.

The shared claim set is also established: the mixed refuge community of 1,200–2,000 under the founder's dynasty and council compact with first succession approaching (restated, not re-litigated); author-facing non-exhaustive strand classes; no exclusive or complete System truth anywhere; uneven literacy and historical memory; and every strand class open as a possible protagonist origin.

Declared qualitative closure of WLD-ECOLOGY-004's open practice space: corridor-season watch duty exists as a routine practice; exact practices remain open, and no field or road is identified as a secondary-path overlap.

Declared qualitative closure of WLD-LOCATION-002's open customary-practice space: a routine cross-strand haulage crewing custom exists; its exact form remains open, and the accepted travel bands are not divided, extended, shortened, or recalculated.
WLD-CULTURE-002 owns the compact's structure, offices, decision classes, representation, and succession provisions; this decision establishes only that watch duty exists and is crewed across strands.
WLD-ECOLOGY-006's mortality-channel-only boundary stands untouched; the spring pulse appears only as prose-level labour pressure, and harvest institutions of every kind remain open.

Strand, braid, class, crew, watch, festival, lore, and every other label are author-facing qualitative descriptions fixing no in-world name, language, classification, ritual content, institution, office, law, measurement, proportion, or performance guarantee.
No demographic percentage or strand proportion is established; WLD-RARITY-001D's deferral of universal proportions stands.
The fabric is author-side cultural truth as a pattern, not automatic character knowledge; standing pressures at story start are not occurred events.
No new System mechanic, CAL0 change, project-default adoption, or development of the parked sapient pack species is created.
residual_unknowns: All in-world names, languages, and linguistic logic for strands, festivals, institutions, and lores remain open.
Strand constituencies, representation pressures, and designed compact ambiguities within WLD-CULTURE-002's accepted structure remain open.
The protagonist's origin strand, if any, and the series contract generally remain open.
Faith content, cosmology, awakening and coming-of-age customs, and guardianship practice remain open.
Specific festival calendars, ritual content, foodways, costume, crafts, and teaching institutions remain open.
Actual demographic composition, strand sizes, household counts, and settlement-interior arrangement remain open.
Content and accuracy of specialist System study — schools, records, rival theories, archives — remain open.
Which craft advantages are hoarded, by whom, and their real versus believed efficacy remain open.
Relations with returning non-human peoples and other surviving human communities remain open and undeveloped.
Harvest, preservation, trade, and shore practice of every kind remain open.
The settlement's remembered collapse and founding versus what WLD-HISTORY-001 establishes actually occurred remains open.
reopening_conditions: Later accepted demographic, festival, institutional, or succession work cannot support several persistent strands braided under negotiated common institutions.
WLD-CULTURE-002 or its successors cannot be reconciled with negotiated common institutions and cross-strand crewing.
Later accepted System-study or lore work requires a strand-privileged truth channel contradicting the layered practice classes.
Later accepted ecology or location work makes routine cross-strand haulage crewing or corridor-season watch duty unsupportable within the accepted bands and boundaries.
The Author explicitly chooses another integration pattern.
